title: WPSS/441/2013 of Nanadan Singh Negi Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No.441 of 2013
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate
with Mr. Chetan Sharma, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate and
Mr. Neeraj Mehrotra, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. U.K. Uniyal, Advocate General with
Mr. Paresh Tripathi, Additional Chief Standing
Counsel for the State of
Uttarakhand/respondents.

Heard.
Amendment application is allowed. Let
necessary amendment be incorporated within one
week by way of filing amended copy of the writ
petition.
(Impleadment Appl. No.5428 of 2013)
 Heard.
 Impleadment application is allowed. Let
necessary impleadment be incorporated within
one week by way of filing amended memo of
parties.
 Issue notice to the newly impleaded
respondents returnable within a period of three
weeks.
WPMS No. 441 of 2013

Heard learned counsel for the parties.
 An interim order was passed by this Court
on 08.03.2013. Learned Advocate General tried
to justify the impugned order on the ground that
land in question was leased out to Rehabilitation
Directorate, Tehri Dam Project, Dehradun for
rehabilitation of displaced persons from Tehri

Dam project subject to fulfillment of some
conditions. One such condition was that the
forest land shall not be used for any other
purpose other than that specified in the proposal
and another was that in case land is not required,
it shall be surrendered back to the State Forest
Department. He submitted that in such
circumstances, the land could not be transferred
in favour of T.H.D.C. on above basis and also in
anticipation of approval of the government.
 Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate
and Mr. Chetan Sharma, Senior Advocate for the
petitioner argued that in any case no adverse
order could be passed without affording
opportunity of hearing to the aggrieved party. He
further submitted that the respondent has allotted
that land in question to certain person, who again
has sold the land to bhumafias.
 I have considered the submission of
learned counsel for the parties. Considering their
submission and also considering the papers
annexed with the pleading, I vacate the interim
order dated 08.03.2013. However, fresh order is
passed by directing the parties to maintain status
quo in respect of property in question. Vacation
of interim order should not create any confusion
in the mind of parties as I have passed fresh
order.
 List this petition on 29th July, 2013.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
21.06.2013
